Public expenditure on education in the EU is slowly recovering, especially as a share of total public 
expenditure. It had declined from 10% in 2019 to 9. 3% in 2020 during the Covid induced - recession and 
remained roughly constant in 2021 and 2022 at historically low levels , before slightly increasing to 9.6% in 
2023. As a share of GDP, it spike d to 4.9% in 2020 due to a strong GDP contraction (European Commission, 
2022), then it reverted to its pre -pandemic trend, with a minor rise between 2022 and 2023, from 4.6%  to 
4.7% (Figure 5). Variations at country level between 2022 and 2023 were usually rather small (see Annex A.1).
